title: Switch between main app sections from the splash screen
description: This test verifies that a visitor can wait for the splash screen to finish and then switch between the main SPA sections using bottom navigation, with each selected section becoming visible.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Wait for the splash screen to complete
Click the navigation control for the home section
Verify the home section is displayed
Click the navigation control for the explore section
Verify the explore section is displayed
Click the navigation control for the map section
Verify the map section is displayed
Click the navigation control for the profile section
Verify the profile section is displayed

title: Reach the admin dashboard after unlocking the legacy gate
description: This test verifies that an authenticated admin can load municipality data, unlock the legacy security gate, and access the secured admin dashboard content.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Open the admin page
Fill in the legacy security password with the correct testing password
Submit the admin gate
Verify the admin dashboard content is displayed
Verify municipality data is displayed

title: Keep the app locked until the splash screen finishes
description: This test verifies that the initial splash state blocks normal interaction until loading completes and then allows navigation afterward.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Attempt to click the profile navigation control before the splash screen completes
Verify the app remains on the splash/loading state
Wait for the splash screen to complete
Click the navigation control for the profile section
Verify the profile section is displayed

title: Open the app and switch between the main SPA sections

steps.description: Navigate to /
Wait for the splash screen to finish
Open the Inici section
Open the Explorar section
Open the Mapa section
Open the Perfil section
Verify the SPA section content changes as expected
Verify the profile section is accessible from the main navigation
